//ApiSettings: Default VaultGuard API server the web app talks to in API mode. Overridden per-user by the shared 'ApiBaseUrl' setting, and to localhost in appsettings.Development.json for local dev.
//Fido2: WebAuthn / passkey Relying Party. ServerDomain MUST equal the host the browser is on (no scheme/port) and Origins MUST list the full https origin(s) of the deployed site — otherwise passkey creation fails on the real domain. Local dev overrides these to localhost in appsettings.Development.json.
